column1: # Isolating fixture for the gates/ arm of the converse check.
# Every count here MATCHES what its stub reports, and scripts/ holds no
# unregistered gate. So paths 1-3 of tests/gates/ratchet/dirty/ are all clean and
# this tree has exactly ONE defect:
# That isolation is the point. The sibling dirty/ tree fails for three other
# reasons, so it exits 1 whether or not the ratchet scans gates/ at all — it
# cannot distinguish a working converse check from one blind to the directory
# Only a tree whose sole defect lives in gates/ can tell those apart.
# Against the pre-2026-08-08 glob (`scripts/gate-*.sh context/gates/*.sh`) this
# tree exits 0. That is the bug, and this file is what fails when it returns.
